subject: GCP co-sell permission — short customer snippet & logo
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira@orchidai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP co-sell permission — short customer snippet & logo

Hi Samira,

Hope you're well. We're finalizing the GCP Marketplace co-sell entry for Redwood and would love to feature Orchid AI as an early production customer. Two quick asks that would help us move forward this week: 

1) A one-line blurb (1–2 sentences) we can use on the Marketplace listing and co-sell collateral that summarizes the business impact you've seen from Redwood.
2) A high-res logo (PNG or SVG) and permission to display Orchid AI's logo + short blurb on the Marketplace listing and in joint marketing. We have a brief permission template attached — if you could sign and return that (PDF) that would be ideal.

Example blurb for context (feel free to rewrite): 
“Redwood’s inference platform reduced our average batch latency while lowering per-token spend, enabling faster product iterations.”

If you'd prefer, Marcus can hop on a 15-minute call to align on wording. We aim to submit to GCP by Friday for the upcoming co-sell wave.

Thanks so much — really appreciate it.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
attachments: permission-template.docx

From: Samira Khan <samira@orchidai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
Cc: Orchid AI Legal <legal@orchidai.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 13:07:22 -0500
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell permission — short customer snippet & logo

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the note — happy to help. Please use the following blurb and attached assets: 

Blurb (feel free to trim):
“Redwood’s inference platform cut our batch processing latency by ~45% and reduced per-token inference costs, which unlocked a real-time feature set for our customers.”

Attachments included: OrchidAI_logo_rgb.png, OrchidAI_permission_signed.pdf (signed permission).

Legal flagged one small edit in the permission form (we added a clause clarifying the logo use will not be used in paid media without separate approval). I've attached the signed PDF with that note. If you'd like us to use a slightly different sentence for the public listing (shorter / less technical), we suggest: 

Short option: “Redwood helped us lower latency and inference costs, enabling faster product delivery.”

If you prefer me to connect you with our marketing lead for a logo version or alternate wording, tell me and I’ll introduce them.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform
Orchid AI
attachments: orchidai_logo_rgb.png, orchidai_permission_signed.pdf
